description: Merges the supplied preference fields into the account's stored preferences and refreshes matching. compensation.kind is open or minimum; minimum requires minimumAmount, an ISO-4217 currency and an hour or year period. seniorities accepts one override level; an empty list restores resume-derived seniority. excludedCompanies, excludedPlaces and excludedSeniorities replace the lists of companies, places and levels hidden from matches, alerts and Autopilot; an excludedPlaces name that cannot be placed refuses the write. Autopilot never applies below the pay floor or outside the accepted work modes. Work modes and relocation are stored together, with omitted values preserved.

acceptedWorkModes.description: Every work setting they accept. Autopilot never applies outside it, and for someone who works only remotely it skips a listing that states no setting.

aiRoleInterest.description: How much they want AI-centred roles. AVOID demotes them.

availability.description: `null` withdraws it, which stops applications until it is answered again.

anyOf.description: A USD per-year minimum must be between 10,000 and 1,000,000; other currencies and hourly rates are unbounded.

compensation.description: The person's pay floor. This is where salary lives. Autopilot never applies to a role whose posted pay tops out below an annual floor; a role that posts no pay is still judged on the rest. `null` withdraws it, which stops applications until it is answered again.

dealBreakers.description: Free-text notes the fit check reads in each posting. They do not hide matches: a term of three words or fewer, such as an industry, only ranks listings whose title, company or industry contains it lower. Job alerts and Autopilot skip a role when the fit check finds a deal-breaker in it, but that is a model's reading, not a rule. A rule that must hold goes in its own key: a company in `excludedCompanies`, a place in `excludedPlaces`, a level in `excludedSeniorities`, pay in `compensation`, work setting in `acceptedWorkModes`. When a deal-breaker names one of those, offer to set the key instead.

excludedCompanies.description: Companies never to show in matches, job alerts or Autopilot. A name hides that company, the companies it owns, the parent brand of a division (`Walmart Global Tech` hides `Walmart`) and longer company names that begin with it (`Amazon` hides `Amazon Web Services`), so use the shortest name that is still specific. A name with no Latin letters or digits, or made only of legal forms like `Inc`, is refused. This REPLACES the list: to add one, include the current ones from get_preferences. It does not block a manual apply or remove saved jobs.

excludedPlaces.description: Places never to show in matches, job alerts or Autopilot: each a city, a state or region, or a country, as the person names it (`Kirkland`, `Bellevue, WA`, `California`). A city hides that city only, not its metro, so list each suburb. Remote roles are never hidden by a place. A name that cannot be placed refuses the whole write and names it, so ask which city they mean (`Eastside` is not a place; `Bellevue`, `Redmond` and `Kirkland` are). This REPLACES the list: to add one, include the current ones from get_preferences.

excludedSeniorities.description: Levels never to show in matches, job alerts or Autopilot, such as `["STAFF", "PRINCIPAL"]` for someone who wants senior roles and nothing above. A role whose level is not classified is not hidden. This REPLACES the list; `[]` clears it.

preferredLocations.description: Where they want to work, not where they live.

seniorities.description: The level to match at, as a one-item list. It ranks roles; it hides none. `[]` drops back to the level read off the resume. To keep roles at other levels out of matches and Autopilot, use `excludedSeniorities`.

tailoredResumesEnabled.description: Whether each application gets a resume rewritten for the role, on the person's own Apply and on Autopilot. False sends their default resume instead, unless they picked a version on that application.

targetFunctions.description: Up to three of these labels; this REPLACES the list, so to add one include the current ones from get_preferences or the situation.
